<thought>Search the template catalog using the deprotected product SMILES (which lacks the silyl protecting group) and criteria that match a DIBAL‑H reduction: breaking a carboxylic ester and forming an aldehyde and an aliphatic hydroxyl.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["carboxylic esters"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aldehydes", "aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
